Tätigkeitsbereich: IT/TelekommunikationFachabteilung: OperationsGesellschaft: Mercedes pay GmbHStandort: BerlinStartdatum: 01.03.2026Veröffentlichungsdatum: 01.03.2026Stellennummer: MER0003ZHRArbeitszeit: Full timeAufgabenWHAT WE DOAs the FinTech hub of Mercedes‑Benz, we connect the world of mobility with the world of payments. Our mission is simple: Transform transactions into the best possible customer experience — inside the car and beyond.What does that mean in practice? We make our customers’ lives easier by allowing them to pay for Mercedes-Benz goods and services across the entire customer lifecycle: from the purchase phase (initial financing/leasing rate, online reservation payments or down payments to full vehicle payments) through the usage phase (car-related services like fueling, charging or Digital Extras or the e-Vignette from the Mercedes-Benz Store) all the way to the retention phase (early contract settlement).ABOUT MERCEDES PAYMercedes pay as a platform was launched in 2018 and is now live in 45+ markets across the globe, playing a central role in the digital business model of Mercedes‑Benz.We enable payments across all customer touchpoints, no matter where the customers are: via app, web, at the Point of Sale and even the car itself. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Stuttgart, Berlin and Singapore.Our solutions enable:- Digital Extras & subscriptions- Mobility services like fueling and charging- e-Commerce (ATC)- Online vehicle sales and full vehicle payment (in selected markets)- In-car payments- LoyaltyOUR VALUES & HOW WE WORKWe are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than staying stuck because of unexpected roadblocks.In short: How we work is strongly based on our values of collaboration: Trust, innovation, responsibility, team spirit and belonging.Since we are still building new processes and products alongside our existing ones, everyone has the opportunity to shape our success – from day one!Are you ready to rethink how the world pays for mobility? Join us and help shape the future of payments!YOUR DAY AT GLANCE- You will collaborate in a dynamic, innovation-driven environment where your experience and hands-on attitude are valued- You will set up and maintain our AWS cloud infrastructure, align them with best-practice standards using infrastructure as code, and support the rollout of new payment products and services from an infrastructure perspective- You will support releases and ensure the reliable operation of CI/CD pipelines, including up-to-date compliance and security checks for our builds and deployments- You will further develop our data pipeline and integrate it with other systems- You will leverage Datadog features to monitor changes to our infrastructure- You will contribute to IT Operations activities during the rollout of products to new markets and use cases- You will collaborate with Mercedes-Benz Group IT specialists and external providers to co-create innovative solutions and contribute to AI-based IT Operations solutions at Mercedes pay- You will play a key role in ensuring the operational excellence of our global payment platformQualifikationenWHAT WE EXPECT- You have a strong passion for IT and bring an open-minded, highly motivated attitude- You have strong solution-oriented, problem-solving, and analytical skills- You are proficient in cloud service architecture best practices and have experience writing infrastructure as code- You are proficient in Terraform, Kubernetes, and Helm, and have experience in software development (e.g. Java), Git SCM, and the Atlassian toolchain- You have successfully completed a relevant degree in Computer Science or have equivalent professional experience- You are willing to participate in an on-call rotation- You have knowledge of IT security best practices and common standards- You are fluent in business English and technical EnglishWHAT WE OFFER- Modern and dynamic work environment- Flexible and mobile working- Attractive fitness offer- Numerous employee discounts- Excellent infrastructureThis is a full-time job (also suitable for part-time). We particularly welcome applications from disabled persons. Please apply online via www.group.mercedes-benz.com/careers (ID:). cecava, a biopharmaceutical immuno-oncology company based in Tübingen (Germany) currently preparing to conduct first clinical trials, is searching for an experiencedBioinformatics (f/m/d)in full timececava is developing personalized cancer immunotherapies derived from tumor-specific mutations that give rise to neoepitopes. The successful candidate will guide the bioinformatics team in developing, validating and documenting bioinformatic pipelines in compliance with GxP regulations supporting their full life cycle management and use in early- and late-stage clinical trials.Your field of responsibility- Provide guidance to the bioinformatics team in developing, validating, documenting and refining computational pipelines that support drug design and manufacturing decisions in early- and late-stage clinical trials- Ensure the full Life Cycle Management of computational pipelines and novel machine learning models is in line with pharmaceutical industry best practice and current US, EU and international guidelines (e.g. FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ICH E6, GAMP5)- Oversee and actively participate in clinical operations of the group, including running pipelines to support ongoing clinical trials- Support the company in establishing and maintaining a GxP-compliant IT-infrastructure- Lead and further develop the bioinformatics team – mentoring and supporting the professional development of team members - Represent the bioinformatics team in cross-functional projects and regulatory interactionsOur expectations- Master's or PhD degree in Bioinformatics, Informatics, Computer Science, Computational Biology, or a related field- At least 3 years of relevant experience working in a regulated environment (preferably GxP) in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or a similarly regulated industry. - Demonstrated experience developing, validating and documenting software for a GxP-regulated environment and according to current regulations (preferably GAMP5)- Sound knowledge of Software Life-Cycle Management according to pharmaceutical industry best practice and current regulations (including versioning, code review, change & risk management)- Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL is expected (knowledge in R, Java, or JavaScript is a plus)- Knowledge in the creation of User Interfaces is a plus- Ideally, experience in conceptualizing, programming, training and testing of ML models - Experience with the development of Next-Generation Sequencing analysis pipelines is a plus- Ideally, a biology background, preferably in oncology, immunology, or immuno-oncology- Leadership experience, including mentoring, managing and developing bio/informatics teams- Excellent organizational, communication and presentation skills, including a good working knowledge of German and English (verbally and in writing)Our offer- An exciting opportunity to contribute to the development of a disruptive technology for the benefit of cancer patients- Work within a dedicated team in an entrepreneurial, innovative, and open-minded working atmosphere- Flat hierarchies and easy access to all company functions- Free drinks and fresh fruits- Job bike and Job ticket (Deutschlandticket)Your applicationPlease send your complete application (including cover letter, CV, certificates, expected availability date, salary expectations, a complete list of publications and 2-3 references) by email and in one PDF document to jobs@cecava.com.We look forward to receiving your application

jobs.description: Job Posting: Team Lead Applied AI Engineering / Forward-Deployed AI 2 LeadLocation: GlobalDepartment: DI AUT IT AIDA AI 2Job Grade: non senior management / ÜT fähigMode of Employment: Permanent / Full-time & Part-timeGRIP: IT-IT-INTEC-TL999 / IT Team LeaderExternal Posting?: NoHiring Manger: Belen BandieraThe official start of this Leadership role is planned for October 1st 2026. As part of our transformation towards ONE Tech Company it plays a key role in shaping the future of our organization.What we offer you- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests- (Global) development programs that can be customized according to your wishes and ambitions- Diverse health and wellness offerings- A work environment where you can contribute with your whole personality and truly feel like part of SiemensSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here.The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and devleopment opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.Transform the everyday.In this role, you will lead a team of Applied AI Engineers working closely with Siemens DI functions to identify, design, deliver, and operate impactful AI solutions. You will help stakeholders understand what is possible with AI, translate domain challenges into concrete impactful use cases, and guide solutions from early discovery through prototype, MVP, and production readiness.How you will make an Impact with us- Lead a team of Applied AI Engineers delivering impactful AI solutions for Siemens DI business functions.- Partner with domain/functions experts and business stakeholders to transform internal processes with AI.- Translate business pain points or business process into clear AI use cases, technical solution concepts, value KPIs, and delivery plans.- Guide AI solutions from consulting and PoV/prototype through MVP and production-ready operation.- Provide technical leadership on AI architecture, software engineering, evaluation, monitoring, and security.- Coach AI engineers in both technical excellence and stakeholder-facing consulting.- Build trust with senior stakeholders by explaining AI opportunities, limitations, risks, and value potential.- Ensure AI solutions are robust, secure, maintainable, compliant, and measurable.- Collaborate with DI IT, HUB, platform teams, cybersecurity, legal, worker-council stakeholders, product teams, and domain organizations.What you bring- 5+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, or software engineering.- 2+ years of experience leading AI engineers/ Data Scientist, or complex cross-functional technical software initiatives.- Proven hands-on experience designing, building, and delivering AI/ML solutions cloud first, including evaluation, guardrails, and observability.- Strong software engineering foundation, including Python, APIs, data pipelines, CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and production operations in the cloud.- Ability to communicate effectively with both executives and AI engineers.- Strong business-value orientation and ability to define measurable business outcomes and drive the technical implantation to measure them after go live.- Experience in enterprise environments with security, compliance, data governance, and integration constraints.- High ownership, pragmatic judgment, and the ability to create clarity in ambiguous situations.- In this role, your focus will be on sales (configuration, pricing, quoting, sales ops & performance) related business functions and SHERPA related use cases.You are the right person if- You can walk into a domain conversation, understand the real process, and identify where AI could create value.- You are obsessed with creating real measurable impact with AI- You can inspire stakeholders with what is possible, helping them transform the way they work in their departments with AI, while staying grounded in feasibility, data, risk, and measurable impact.- You can guide your team in architecture and challenge engineering decisions.- You enjoy developing people and raising the engineering bar.- You want to build AI solutions that move beyond demos and become sustainable, production-ready capabilities.Languages: Fluent in English, additional languages are a plusYou are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!Please note, this position will be based in the Siemens location where the selected candidate currently is located. The role has been assessed as a level (TL999). The actual compensation range will vary based on work location, applicable salary structure, experience, qualifications, and internal equity. Candidates will receive compensation information relevant to their location during the recruitment process in accordance with local legal requirements and Siemens compensation practices. For further information regarding the compensation details that apply to you and your country, please contact the recruiter directly.At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career.  From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce. At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us.As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/about/social-commitments/belonging/) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities. In the case of equal qualifications, severely disabled applicants and applicants with equivalent status will be given preferenceAbout usSiemens Digital Industries Automation (DI AUT) is one of the world’s leading providers of industrial automation. Our innovative automation portfolio enables companies of all sizes in both the process and discrete manufacturing industries to accelerate their automation—and thus their digital transformation—across the entire value chain. This allows our customers to increase productivity and flexibility and become future-ready through technologies such as software-defined systems and artificial intelligence. Siemens Xcelerator—the open digital business platform—helps to implement this more easily, quickly, and at scale. Together with partners and a broad ecosystem, Siemens supports its customers on their journey toward becoming a Digital Enterprise. otc2026di

As an (Associate) Vice President (f/m/d) at Siemens Advanta’s Strategy and Innovation Practice, you will serve as a senior leader overseeing pivotal domains: Delivery, Business Development, and People & Capability Building. Leveraging advanced expertise and leadership acumen, you will help define the next era of digitalization by crafting groundbreaking strategies and transformation roadmaps for Siemens and its global customers. The role entails direct responsibility for shaping business success, managing high-value projects, and serving as a trusted advisor for customer executives at C-level.Building on Siemens Advanta’s legacy as a global management consultancy powerhouse, the (Associate) Vice President role combines strategic depth, operational ownership, and cultural leadership—providing exposure to innovation-driven industries such as electrification, automation, and digitalization. **Ready to take your vision to the next level? Be part of a team where strategy meets technology, and innovation drives global impact.**How you will make an impact with us:- Delivery Excellence:- Act as a trusted advisor to our customers, shaping strategic agendas and transformation roadmaps with your thought leadership.- Take operational and financial responsibility for acquiring and delivering high quality projects.- Oversee multidisciplinary teams in complex consulting engagements and large-scale programs to deliver innovative, tailored digital and organizational solutions for global industrial customers.- Business Growth:- Shape strategic customer opportunities through thought leadership, innovative methodologies, and differentiated consulting approaches at the intersection of strategy, digitalization, and technology.- Lead the development of compelling value propositions, proposals, and solution concepts for complex transformation initiatives in close collaboration with Customer Partners and senior customer stakeholders.- Build trusted relationships with C-level executives, acting as a strategic advisor and fostering long-term partnerships across complex stakeholder environments.- Leverage Siemens’ unique expertise in industrial technology, automation, digitalization, and AI to create measurable value for customers and strengthen Siemens Advanta’s market positioning and growth.- People & Capability Building- Develop differentiating methodologies, foster team growth, mentor employees, and build Consulting Excellence within the organization.- Inspire, coach, and grow high-performing, diverse teams ensuring an inclusive, performance-oriented consulting culture.What you bring:- Education: - Master’s degree or MBA from a top-tier university is desirable.- Backgrounds in engineering, physics, natural sciences, or strategic management are highly valued.- Experience & Skills- Extensive consulting experience (8 - 12+ years), with a proven track record as Principal, (Associate) Partner or VP at a top-tier strategy consultancy, or equivalent experience in corporate strategy roles.- Track record in driving significant business growth**,** leading large-scale transformation programs, and building executive-level customer relationships.- Proven track record in leading digital transformation projects for Siemens’ customer base, focusing on industries like automotive and power & utilities.- AI expertise: Strong familiarity with AI-based strategy development and execution, leveraging AI to create impactful industry transformations.- End-to-end experience, ranging from strategy development to hands-on execution for technology-driven and industry-specific transformation projects.- Methodological depth in areas such as Target Operating Model (TOM), cost reduction initiatives, sustainability, and AI transformation.- Working Style & Personality- Ability to thrive in a matrix organization, fostering strong internal partnerships and cross-functional collaboration.- Extensive experience leading international teams and actively creating an inclusive environment.- A leader who develops people, enjoys leading employees, brings diverse perspectives, thinks creatively, and goes beyond standard consulting approaches.- An entrepreneurial mindset and strong analytical acumen.- Languages: The position can be filled in either Munich,Germany or Barcelona,Spain.- Pathway 1: For candidates working in Munich and supporting primarily German-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in English is mandatory, while German is an advantage.- Pathway 2: For candidates working in Barcelona and supporting primarily Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in Spanish is mandatory, with proficiency in Portugese preferred.What we offer you- Attractive Compensation Package: A competitive salary that recognizes your expertise and performance.- Flexible Working Models: Enjoy time for yourself and your family through our flexible working hour models.- Continuous Learning: Benefit from specialized training and daily challenges to keep your expert knowledge up-to-date.- Innovative Environment: Become part of a team that values innovation and continuous improvement.Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usSiemens Advanta provides consulting services in the fields of strategy, operations, AI, and data analytics, as well as solution implementation services, to enable the digital and sustainability transformation of Siemens customers. Leveraging Siemens’ expertise, resources, and its ecosystem of businesses and partners, customers are empowered to unlock the full potential of Siemens technologies. Siemens Advanta elevates customer engagements to an enterprise level, leading transformations through strategic insight and holistic solutions. With pioneering projects bridging across Siemens’ entire portfolio, customers are enabled to leverage the full value of Siemens technologies. With this, Siemens Advanta develops repeatable, scalable and proven solutions that maximize customer value across the entire value chain. jobs.description: WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORKWe are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the #1 ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work (https://www.bain.com/about/awards-recognition/) list and have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor’s list since its founding in 2009. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH Join a group of talent acquisition experts who are the top of their field for attracting and hiring the top of every other field. We manage the full candidate lifecycle and just as Bain is only as good as its people, its people are only as good as our process. If you’re interested in learning how a top management consulting firm creates an impressive candidate experience, this is the team for you.WHAT YOU’LL DO - As Associate, Recruiting (m/f/d), you will support our Intern Hire Team in attracting outstanding talent for consulting internships across our offices in Germany & Austria.- In this role, you will serve as the central point of contact for all candidates throughout the Talent Journey – from the initial contact at a university event through to candidate support during our assessment days.- You will also be responsible for the pre-selection of the most promising candidates for our selection process and will oversee the preparation, execution and follow-up of our assessment days.- You give free rein to your creativity in conceptualizing, planning and executing our campus activities and (flagship) recruiting events, and collaborate with your team colleagues to develop strategies and concepts to further advance our intern hiring.- With your communicative and approachable manner, you also support our internal consultants with all recruiting-related queries.- To make our recruiting success measurable, you regularly prepare analyses along the Talent Journey and present these to your key stakeholders.ABOUT YOU- You have a genuine passion for talent and recruiting.- You leverage your strong communication skills to attract talented individuals to Bain.- You have a strong service orientation and a genuine enthusiasm for daily interaction with candidates and Bainies.- You look forward to taking on responsibility and independently driving topics forward. - You are a resilient and assertive organisational talent who does not shy away from challenges and keeps a cool head under pressure.- You truly thrive in a team setting, built on a foundation of loyalty and reliability.- You are creative, have a sense of humor and impress with a warm and positive presence.YOUR EXPERIENCE- You hold a successfully completed university degree in business administration, social sciences or law, ideally with a focus on human resources management.- You bring initial experience in recruiting and/or campus marketing. - You are proficient in MS Office; initial knowledge of data analytics is an advantage.- Your German and English language skills are excellent, both spoken and writtenWHAT WE OFFER YOUIn addition to an attractive and performance-based remuneration comprising fixed and variable components, you will benefit from numerous additional perks:- Diverse training formats, language courses as well as buddy and mentoring programmes support your personal development- You benefit from the EGYM Wellpass and further offerings for fitness and mental wellbeing- Our mobility concept gives you the flexibility to choose between Mobility Cash, reimbursement of your public transport ticket or JobRad leasing- For us, flexibility means having the best of both worlds: the freedom to work from home and the opportunity to experience genuine team moments in the office – fully in line with our Work@Bain 2.x concept.- With our Community Impact Day and participation in Green Teams, you can make a meaningful difference for society and the environment- Affinity Groups such as Women@Bain promote exchange, networking and career development- Whether Team Retreat, Christmas Party or the „Bain-Wiesn“ – you will experience how fun and team spirit go hand in hand at Bain.- Whether free snacks, beverages or the subsidised catering in our cafeteria (in Munich) – you will find even more at Bain that makes your working day a little bit better.HOW YOU´LL JOIN USHave we sparked your curiosity about an exceptional career with us?
